announcements.text: The Boeing Co., Seattle, Washington, has been awarded a $13,400,000,000 ceiling modification (P00008) to a previously awarded contract (FA8609-19-D-0007) for the addition of Foreign Military Sales (FMS) scope of work. The modification brings the total contract ceiling to $19,100,000,000 from $5,700,000,000. Work will be performed in Seattle, Washington, and is expected to be completed by April 28, 2035. This contract involves FMS to Japan and Israel and will also include future country partners. No funds are being obligated at time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Blue Halo LLC, Huntsville, Alabama, has been awarded a $99,832,117 ceiling indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for the Leveraged Orbital Battlespace Optimization program. This contract provides for research and development to advance scientific knowledge and state-of-the-art technology supporting space systems. Work will be performed in Huntsville, Alabama; and Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico, and is expected to be completed by Aug. 29, 2031. This award is the result of a competitive acquisition, and one offer was received. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $1,696,597 are being obligated at the time of award for two initial task orders (FA9453-26-F-X013 and FA9453-26-F-X014) with a combined ceiling value of $20,178,910 of both task orders. The Air Force Research Laboratory, Kirtland AFB, New Mexico, is the contracting activity (FA9453-26-D-X006).

announcements.text: American Systems Corp., Chantilly, Virginia, is awarded a $30,579,869 modification (P00023) to previously awarded firm-fixed-price contract (N6134022C0001). This modification includes development, integration, testing, and delivery of a software update to the P-8A Virtual Maintenance Trainer, simulating the new Increment 3 Block 2 configuration for both Navy and Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF). Additionally, this action procures critical hardware, software, and courseware updates to integrate the Automated Readiness Measurement System Combat System Increment 3 capabilities for both the Navy and the RAAF under the P-8A Maintenance Training Device Suite program. Work will be performed in Jacksonville, Florida (50%); and Edinburgh, Australia (50%), and is expected to be completed in January 2029. Fiscal 2024 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $8,707,250; fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $7,770,413; and RAAF funds in the amount of $14,112,206, will be obligated at the time of award. This contract was not competed. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

This contract combines purchases for the U.S. government (65%); and the countries of Spain (26%), and Australia (9%), under the Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program. Work will be performed in Marion, Virginia, and is expected to be completed by October 2029. Fiscal 2021 shipbuilding and conversion, Navy funds in the amount of $4,001,543 (65%); and FMS (Spain) funds in the amount of $1,600,617 (26%); and FMS (Australia) funds in the amount of $533,539 (9%), will be obligated at time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Surface Warfare Center, Crane, Indiana, is the contracting activity.
